CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.immutable_unaccent(text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$ SELECT public.unaccent('public.unaccent', $1) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.to_or_tsquery(t text)
 RETURNS tsquery
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
        SELECT to_tsquery('simple',
          nullif(
            array_to_string(
              array(
                SELECT x
                FROM unnest(string_to_array(
                  regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(t, '')), '[^a-z0-9 ]+', ' ', 'g'),
                  ' ')) AS x
                WHERE x <> ''
              ),
              ' | '
            ),
            ''
          )
        )
      $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.translit_cyr_lat(t text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
        SELECT translate(
          regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
          regexp_replace(
            lower(coalesce(t, '')),
            'ж', 'zh', 'g'),
            'ц', 'ts', 'g'),
            'ч', 'ch', 'g'),
            'ш', 'sh', 'g'),
            'щ', 'shch', 'g'),
            'ю', 'yu', 'g'),
            'я', 'ya', 'g'),
          'абвгдеёзийклмнопрстуфхыэъь',
          'abvgdeeziyklmnoprstufhye'
        )
      $function$
